funding_notes: Orb (withorb.com), San Francisco usage-based billing platform founded 2021 by ex-Asana engineers Alvaro Morales and Kshitij Grover. Raised a $5.1M seed led by Greylock (date not disclosed; announced together with the Series A) and a $14M Series A led by Menlo Ventures (announced March 2023), then a $25M Series B led by Mayfield in Sept 2024, which the company said brought total funding to $44.1M. Adyen agreed in June 2026 to acquire Orb for $335M in cash (deal expected to close July 1, 2026). Note: Payments Dive's line that Orb raised '$25 million' refers only to the Series B; the press releases put the total at $44.1M.
